summary: Mobile incident DETAIL screen for fixture 7c20280b-1261-44c6-b109-28c88bb02773 fully verified end-to-end as Demo CGM D500 on Expo web preview. No 404/ErrorRetry: incident-detail-screen mounts cleanly, large photo renders at top (black bg, contain, no watermark/overlay), MetaGrid shows Status/Severity/Captured only (no Distance/AR), incident-people-section renders '(2)' with 2 face thumbs via FaceStrip, incident-plates-section renders '(2)' with PlateSection rows MH12AB1234 (Primary + High confidence 88%) and MH14GH7777 (Medium 71%). Plate edit flow works: tapping plate-row-<id> opens plate-edit-modal, saving MH12XY9999 closes modal + fires 'Number plate updated' toast, after re-render row shows 'Edited' badge + 'Model read: MH12AB1234' (original_text preserved). AR fully removed from /incident/capture: incident-capture-screen mounts, zero occurrences of ar-crosshair/ar-distance-banner/ar-reticle/ar-debug-dot. No RN red screen anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Benign console warnings observed on web preview only: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow' and 'useNativeDriver is not supported' — these are react-native-web runtime warnings and do not affect native builds. No action required.

Two pre-auth 401s hit /api/incidents/.../analysis before the stored token is attached on fresh web mounts; the UI silently swallows them via try/catch in loadAnalysis and re-fetches after auth hydration. Not user-visible but could be tightened by guarding the fetch behind authStore hydration.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Verified pre-existing fixture 7c20280b-1261-44c6-b109-28c88bb02773 (SECURITY, is_demo_seed=true, 2 faces + 2 plates MH12AB1234 primary / MH14GH7777). Test idempotency: edited plate was reverted back to MH12AB1234 at the end of the run so repeated runs still exercise the full edit flow.

Fixture 7c20280b-... is visible ONLY to the demo bubble.
